A versatile professional having 22+ years of rich experience in Contact Center Technologies and CX Initiatives, Service Delivery, Client Management, Account & Program Management, Vendor & Channel Management, Digital Transformation & Automation, Solution Designing, Investment Consulting and People Management(HR) in organizations of high repute.

Executive Profile

A  Service  Delivery  Specialist  having  Robust

experience in giving the effective Managed services to the end customers and keeping the high customer satisfaction without any glitch throughout the career.

Proven Excellence in effective Account management, not only by sustaining the repetitive existing business, also by introducing new products or services into the customer domain and getting additional business continuously.

End to End Client Management (i.e., Solution Designing, Presentation, Requirement Gathering, Scope of Work, complete Project Management to Service Delivery).

Specialist in Vendor Management, helping end customers in getting the desired services for high uptime.

Demonstrated experience in getting the Business from channel partners.

Proven ability to manage stakeholders across all levels.

Strong experience in resource planning, allocation, utilization, and attrition management.

Strong problem-solving skills with ability to translate a vaguely defined business problem into analytical solution framework.

Robust Experience in Call Center Technologies & CX Initiatives, specifically in Service Delivery, Project Management, Operations and Solution Designing.

Rich experience and Expertise in Avaya Technologies

Strong Experience of AWS cloud Contact Center Technology (Amazon Connect), in Presales, Solution Designing, Customer presentation, Requirement Gathering, Project Management, UAT, Training and Go-live Support to premium customers across Globe.

Experienced professional in Genesys Pure Cloud.

Handy experience of working on new RFP’s along with sales team right from analyzing the requirement, Solution design, Compliance assessment, Business proposal and customer presentation.

A competent professional with rich experience in Human Resource Domain. Contributes to company growth through Recruitment and Talent Acquisition, Performance Appraisals, Retention, Learning and Development, Industrial Relations, Compliance Management, Employee Motivations workshops and social welfare schemes for families of Employees.

An effective Communicator with excellent presentation, Interpersonal, analytical, Problem Solving and Leadership Skills.

Rich experience and Strong Knowledge of Life and Health Insurance Industry.

Education

Bachelor of Science fromDELHI UNIVERSITYin 1997.

Master’s	degree	in	“Applied	Psychology”	with	specialization	in	“Organizational Psychology” from JAMIA MILLIA ISLAMIA, in 1999.

MCA from IGNOU in 2006.

Professional Certifications

AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Avaya Certified Support Specialist in “Avaya Aura Call Center Elite Implementation and Maintenance”

ITIL Foundation Certificate, Version 3, in IT Service Management

“Professional Diploma in Human Resource Management” from “All IndiaManagement Association (A.I.M.A)”, Lodi Institutional Area, New Delhi.

Major Achievements

Got the annual CEO award for being the Delivery Champion with AGC Networks in Service Delivery function for the year 2013-14.

Got the CEO individual award for Excellent Service Delivery and complete account management of Genpact (Biggest customer of AGC Networks Ltd.) across the globe, for 3rd Quarter of the year 2014-15.

 Professional Highlights
